training.loss: Execute the exact loss AST extracted from the existing production EDPA-TV script, with unchanged source forwards

reporting.primary: Each seed's equal-weight mean G across all four suites; G=Plain success rate minus attack success rate
reporting.summary: Four-seed arithmetic mean and sample standard deviation (ddof=1) for all three methods
reporting.interpretation: Follow-up comparison on this fixed seed set, not a claim of random sampling from all previously evaluated runs
